item.title: My Complicated Relationship with Reading, Listening, and Learning
item.description: I learn well when I have a problem to solve, but an unfinished idea can take over my attention. From math class to work, I’ve begun to understand the strengths and limits of that habit. I want to keep the persistence—and learn when to pause.
